For \(m=4\), exhaustive enumeration of the box \(\{0,\ldots,4\}^8\) gives 358134 symbolic candidates; there are 316 distinct three-edge load vectors, and every candidate dominates at least one load vector. Thus \(I^{(4)}\subset I^3\). The lower-bound sequence for resurgence follows by degree from the diagonal monomials.
